description: This file provides utility functions for handling images and multimodal messages in a chat UI component, including converting images to base64, creating multimodal messages with images or PDFs, generating display messages, and determining when to show attached images.

methods.name: convertImageToBase64
methods.description: Converts a File object to a base64-encoded string, removing the data URL prefix.

methods.name: createMultimodalMessage
methods.description: Generates a message object containing text and an encoded image or PDF in base64 format for chat display.

methods.name: createDisplayMessage
methods.description: Creates a user message object, appending file attachment info and optional image preview URL.

methods.name: shouldShowAttachedImage
methods.description: Determines whether to display an image preview based on the message content and presence of an image attachment.
